id: \bTake my mind off of my situation for a while.
en: \bTake my mind off of my situation for a while.

id: \bDon't disturb me. I'm looking for a rare Pokémon.
en: \bDon't disturb me. I'm looking for a rare Pokémon.
it: \bNon disturbarmi. Sto cercando un Pokémon raro.

id: \bHave you found a Meltan? I heard they evolve by holding a Rare Candy.
en: \bHave you found a Meltan? I heard they evolve by holding a Rare Candy.
it: \bHai trovato un Meltan? Ho sentito che si evolve tenendo una Caramella Rara.

id: \rLana: Hi \PN. You just missed my friend. She helped me out a lot. Here, take a look.
en: \rLana: Hi \PN. You just missed my friend. She helped me out a lot. Here, take a look.
it: \rSuiren: Ciao \PN. Hai appena mancato la mia amica. Mi ha aiutata tantissimo. Ecco, dai un'occhiata.

id: \rLana: Oh, the Island Kuhuna? I don't know about that, but maybe you can battle Tapu Fini instead at the Ruins of Hope.
en: \rLana: Oh, the Island Kuhuna? I don't know about that, but maybe you can battle Tapu Fini instead at the Ruins of Hope.
it: \rSuiren: Oh, il Kahuna dell'isola? Non saprei, ma forse potresti invece lottare contro Tapu Fini alle Rovine della Speranza.

id: \rIt should be east of the Ancient Poni Path.
en: \rIt should be east of the Ancient Poni Path.
it: \rDovrebbero essere a est dell'Antico Sentiero di Poni.
